# FQHESphereEntanglementSpectrum

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereEntanglementSpectrum`

Manual: [FQHESphereEntanglementSpectrum (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FQHESphereEntanglementSpectrum.md)

```text
FQHESphereEntanglementSpectrum, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereEntanglementSpectrum [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --density-matrix : file containing the reduced density matrix
    -n, --nbr-particles : number of particles in the A part (default value = 0)
    -l, --nbr-orbitals : number of orbitals in the A part (default value = 0)
    -s, --sz-value : twice the Sz value of A part (SU(2) mode only) (default value = 0)
    --su2-spin : consider particles with SU(2) spin (override autodetection from the reduced density matrix file name)
    -o, --output : output name for the entanglement spectrum (default name replace density-matrix full.ent extension with la_x_na_y.entspec)
    -e, --eigenvalue-error : lowest acceptable reduced density matrix eignvalue (default value = 1e-14)
    --show-minmaxlza : show minimum an maximum Lz value that can be reached
    --show-counting : show degeneracy counting for each Lz value
    --particle-entanglement : compute particle entanglement spectrum
    --discrete-symmetries : the reduced density matrix spectrum includes discrete symmetry information such as Sz<->-Sz
    --ls-sorted : for the particle entanglement spectrum with su2-spin on the sphere, sort the spectrum with respect to L and S

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
